goldLabelScope: Entire file; this measures pipeline coverage and delayed context, not intrinsic model accuracy on identical inputs.
gate: Dev must attempt all, candidate correct 2/2 with no new false alerts/errors. Test must attempt all, candidate at least 5/6 content-correct, no new benign alerts/errors and strictly more correct whole-file outcomes. UNKNOWN/errors remain incorrect. Stop after 3 consecutive provider failures. Freeze before dev and do not retune on test.
limitations: Controlled TTS, one voice, no claim of human/clone forensic accuracy, real-call quality or always <3s.
